parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="10.5" y="240" width="810" height="250" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="CUqyRYsr0oTTPgaSo3Wl-36" value="RPA Process&nbsp;PurposefulPromethium, v1.x "legacy"<div><br></div><div><span style="font-weight: normal;">This process automates the extraction, validation, and submission of email data for streamlined handling of structured information. It begins by configuring the environment, accessing emails through an IMAP connection, and categorizing messages based on their subject format. Relevant data is parsed from each email's body, isolating key-value pairs essential for entry into the designated application, rpachallenge.com. After submission, the process checks for errors: if successful, the email data is archived in a success folder; if not, it is flagged and moved to an error folder. In both cases, the email is zipped and uploaded to an FTP server for storage or audit purposes. The process concludes by closing the browser, ensuring data is handled consistently with minimal manual intervention.&nbsp;</span></div>" div.div:
RPA Process PurposefulPromethium, v1.x "legacy"
This process automates the extraction, validation, and submission of email data for streamlined handling of structured information. It begins by configuring the environment, accessing emails through an IMAP connection, and categorizing messages based on their subject format. Relevant data is parsed from each email's body, isolating key-value pairs essential for entry into the designated application, rpachallenge.com. After submission, the process checks for errors: if successful, the email data is archived in a success folder; if not, it is flagged and moved to an error folder. In both cases, the email is zipped and uploaded to an FTP server for storage or audit purposes. The process concludes by closing the browser, ensuring data is handled consistently with minimal manual intervention.
